title: Design: Queue from Two Stacks
hints: Two stacks: push into one, pop from the other.
Only when the outbox is empty, move everything from the inbox (reversed) into it.
`if outbox.isEmpty { outbox = inbox.reversed(); inbox.removeAll() }; return outbox.popLast()` — and `peek` is `outbox.last ?? inbox.first`.
jsBridge: The classic amortised O(1) queue. The Swift twist: `peek` must be non-mutating, which forces you to reason about which stack holds the front without moving elements. A JS class wouldn't enforce that.
